arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/home')
import parse

# Test edge cases
tests = [
    ('{name:d}', '0x1a'),  # hex in decimal field
    ('{name:d}', '0b101'),  # binary in decimal field  
    ('{name:d}', '0o75'),  # octal in decimal field
    ('{name:d}', '-42'),  # negative
    ('{name:d}', '+42'),  # positive sign
]

for fmt, s in tests:
    r = parse.parse(fmt, s)
    print(f'{fmt!r} on {s!r}: {r.named if r else None}')
" 2>&1
